standard.summary: 按实际 caption 分类分别计算辅助损失；Anima 保留既有 scorer，Newbie/SD3 仅支持 Latent 统计对照。默认关闭。
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

standard_en.summary: Compute auxiliary losses for actual caption categories. Newbie/SD3 support latent statistics only; Anima keeps its existing scorers. Off by default.
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

advanced.principle: 类别来自最终选中的 JSON caption；新缓存保存类别，旧缓存无类别时跳过，可显式重建补齐。sigma 筛选后按类别选择样本。Latent scorer 比较统计特征，不产生自动身份/风格语义标签。

advanced_en.principle: Categories follow the selected JSON caption and cache variant. Legacy caches without metadata are skipped until explicitly rebuilt. Each category uses its own samples within the sigma window; latent statistics are not semantic labels.
